notes.title: Symmetry Launch - May 2024

Keep an eye on the Community Hub for updates leading up to the release.

notes.title: SYMMETRY V2.0 - NOW AVAILABLE IN 10 LANGUAGES
notes.notes:
[h3][b]SYMMETRY HAS GONE INTERNATIONAL IN THE V2.0 UPDATE![/b][/h3]
The intense platformer is now available in [b]9 new languages[/b], with more to be added soon.

[b]AVAILABLE LANGUAGES:[/b]
[b]French, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese[/b]

[b]Other languages[/b] soon to be released include: [b]Italian & Turkish[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/ae25afe16bb498b16065153bc4c1530500f88f62.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]GAME UPDATES[/b][/h3]
Alongside this, there have been updates to the gameplay, including:

[b]Timer reset at the start of a level (Solo Mode)[/b]
If the player respawns at the start of a level, the timer will automatically reset, saving the player reloading the level to try again.

[b][b]Bug fixes[/b]

Updated button/key bindings[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/8dbd85e6f46166e9cb6621062ba3b11a9b34a392.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]A NEW MODE COMING SOON[/b][/h3]
The ball doesn't stop rolling here, because the new mode '[b]RUSH[/b]' will be following the V2.0 update very soon! This will take place on a [b]brand new track[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/d7e01c027b58af0f14d36eb33a8319150b8b0143.jpg[/img]

Have you tested your nerve in Symmetry yet?

notes.title: REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER
notes.notes:
[b]Great news! A new feature 'Remote Play Together' is on its way![/b]

This is perfect for Symmetry, and will allow the multiplayer modes [b]'Race'[/b] and [b]'Domination'[/b] to be played remotely as of October 21st.

Time to get practising! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544108/5656c4d9950348a44138b7e423812729cedbd9d7.jpg[/img]

For more information:
https://www.pcgamer.com/steams-remote-play-together-will-introduce-online-support-for-all-local-multiplayer-games/

notes.title: Symmetry is out now!
notes.notes:
A day earlier than planned, I can now announce that Symmetry is available to download.

This has been an extremely fun project to work on so far, and even though I've play tested it for more hours than I can remember, I still find myself trying to beat my best times and win against friends on multiplayer modes.

This is a very different game to my previous one and has provided its fair share of challenges throughout development. I can now (briefly) relax before continuing to make Symmetry the best platforming/multiplayer experience it possibly can be.

The main aim for Symmetry is to have fun, solo or with friends, so make sure to download it today and let me know your thoughts!

Thanks to all those who have helped to make this release possible.

Dean
